statement.excerpt: The completely imaginary assumption about the AI industry is that it’ll magically get cheaper. That is not something that’s happening. More data centers will not make OpenAI or Anthropic profitable. More data centers will not make customers more willing to pay the actual cost of AI. More venture capital funding will not make Anthropic or OpenAI real businesses.

our_interpretation: This combines a present observation with several forecasts. The forecast outcome is the principal assessment axis.
The ordinary reading of cheaper concerns the cost of comparable useful AI service. Customer prices, provider production costs, and total company spending must be distinguished.
For the present-tense component, I use January–March 2026, the latest completed reportable calendar quarter before the post, with comparison to earlier periods.
In context, real businesses means businesses able to cover their continuing costs from customers, rather than merely legally incorporated companies.
The data-center and funding statements predict causal effects. Profitability following expansion alone would not establish that expansion caused it.
A sustained profitability test means at least two consecutive comparable quarters including training and compensation. This persistence threshold is an evaluator choice.
No deadline or accounting basis is specified.
criteria.support_condition: Period-matched evidence supports the present cost observation, and credible causal evidence supports the proposed limits of expansion and funding. A finite period of losses cannot establish the unlimited future negatives.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sustained, documented transition to full-cost profitability attributable to added capacity or funding refutes the relevant forecast. Evidence that customers sustain purchases covering actual costs because of the expansion refutes the willingness-to-pay forecast. Comparable cost declines can refute the narrower present observation without settling the forecasts.

Anthropic reports a later reduction in inference-compute requirements, challenging an unrestricted claim of no efficiency improvement. This is company-reported, postdates the historical component, and does not establish full-company profitability.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: For the observation, period-matched comparable-task price and provider-cost data. For the forecasts, sustained full-cost results and customer payments with evidence establishing the contribution of added capacity or funding.
